non_goals: No implementation, edits, formatting, staging, commits, pushes, handoffs, ledger writes, dispatch creation, or further delegation.
No HCM-3.x, Resolution, Projection, public API, dependency, Cargo, package, transport, SDK, migration, dual-read, dynamic command, or sibling-slice expansion.

tasks: Verify the manifested subject identity and inspect the scoped diff.

Return findings first, ordered Critical, Required, Optional, Nit; each finding must include severity, file and line, violated contract or gate, boundary/proof failure, smallest valid remediation, and missing verification.
Return CLEAN only when no valid P1/P2 remains; separately list any validated P3/P4 advisory or its exact inventory deduplication.

Report rather than repair any defect, scope expansion, unavailable proof, or authority conflict.
